senses.sense_definition: de armen om iets of iemand slaan als teken van genegenheid

examples.text: Toen ze haar oude vriend na jaren weer zag, wilde ze hem meteen hartelijk <w>omhelzen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: When she saw her old friend again after years, she immediately wanted to <w>embrace</w> him warmly.
target_lang_translations.it: Quando ha rivisto il suo vecchio amico dopo anni, ha voluto subito <w>abbracciarlo</w> calorosamente.

examples.text: Hij wordt hartstochtelijk <w>omhelsd</w> door een bewonderaarster na het concert.

target_lang_translations.en: He is passionately <w>hugged</w> by a female admirer after the concert.
target_lang_translations.it: Viene <w>abbracciato</w> appassionatamente da una ammiratrice dopo il concerto.

target_lang_definitions.en: to put one's arms around something or someone as a sign of affection
target_lang_definitions.it: stringere qualcuno o qualcosa tra le braccia come segno di affetto

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to clasp in the arms with affection
to hold tightly in one's arms

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: stringere tra le braccia una persona

senses.sense_definition: een idee, geloof of levenswijze <w>aannemen</w> en steunen

examples.text: Het bedrijf besloot de nieuwe technologie volledig te <w>omhelzen</w> om de concurrentie voor te blijven.

target_lang_translations.en: The company decided to fully <w>embrace</w> the new technology to stay ahead of the competition.
target_lang_translations.it: L'azienda ha deciso di <w>abbracciare</w> completamente la nuova tecnologia per restare davanti alla concorrenza.

examples.text: Dat twee van zijn kinderen de kloosterlijke staat <w>omhelsden</w>, heeft hem lang verdroten.

target_lang_translations.en: The fact that two of his children <w>adopted</w> the monastic life grieved him for a long time.
target_lang_translations.it: Il fatto che due dei suoi figli abbiano <w>abbracciato</w> la vita monastica lo ha addolorato a lungo.

target_lang_definitions.en: to adopt and support an idea, belief, or way of life
target_lang_definitions.it: accettare, fare propria o sostenere un'idea, una fede o uno stile di vita

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to accept or take up with cordiality
to take up or start to use
to adopt or support a cause or belief

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: accettare o seguire un'idea o una causa
fare propria una scelta o un modo di vivere
